title: Review: RSA, ECDH, ECDSA wolfssl providers; build fixes
notes: Confidence calibration (2026-04-18): High confidence (~90%) on WOLFKM-6ty.1 (wolfssl_rsa_xlat_err(-22) → -EIO), WOLFKM-6ty.3 (memcmp not constant-time), WOLFKM-6ty.4 (SHA-1 digest accepted by FIPS-gated ECDSA). High confidence (~85%) on WOLFKM-6ty.2 (wrong errno type), WOLFKM-6ty.5 (curve mismatch not caught), WOLFKM-6ty.7 (static bodies in header). Medium confidence (~70%) on WOLFKM-6ty.6 (okm_len bound — depends on whether ioctl_do_agree validates this before calling provider; did not read full ioctl_do_agree in this review). Medium confidence (~75%) on WOLFKM-6ty.9 (rsa-4096 accepting 2048-bit key — need to confirm FIPS requires algo-name-exact size enforcement). Files NOT read in this review: full ioctl_do_agree handler, wolfssl_aes_gcm.c, wolfssl_hmac.c, tests/vectors/rsa.h.
close_reason: All 13 actionable issues resolved: 5 P0 bugs fixed, 5 P1 risks addressed, P3/P4 elegance/readability improved. 4 decision records archived.
